summary: Promote transfers durable backup repositories, policies, runs and catalog index from the signed authority replica; empty catalog rebuilds from NFS manifests.

guide.reason: Operator-visible promote and backup workflows are unchanged; this restores Core takeover of already-documented backup authority after fence-verified promotion.

api.reason: PoolBackupAuthority on the signed pool authority replica now carries repositories, full policy definitions, retained runs and catalog index for takeover (additive fields; compact refs retained). No new Controller HTTP routes.

roadmap.reason: Closes the Campaign B backup-takeover Core gap; Phase 6 gate stays open until live multi-host campaigns and remaining slices close.

state.record: Master pool-backup-repositories.json, pool-backup-policies.json, pool-backup-runs/ and pool-backup-catalog/ remain Core-owned. Signed pool authority replica backup_authority now replicates those durable records (catalog index only). On promote, adoptPoolAuthorityFromReplica materializes them on the survivor; empty catalog with a usable repository mount rebuilds from NFS manifests. Fresh Controller adopts the same IDs from the new master's inventory.
state.reason: Backup jobs/history must survive master loss without Controller-owned copies.

verification.method: go test -count=1 -timeout 120s ./internal/agent/ -run 'PoolPromotionRetainsBackupAuthority|PoolPromotionRebuildsCatalogFromNFSWhenIndexEmpty|AdoptPoolBackupAuthorityAndRebuildFromMount|PoolBackupAuthorityRefsDoesNotReenterPeerLock|PoolPromotion|AdoptPoolAuthority'; go test -count=1 ./internal/protocol/ -run 'BackupPolicy'; python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_repository_privacy.py'; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree. Live nested Campaign B re-run optional.
